description: Mechanical retrieval of one ticket: raw issue, field metadata, every comment page, linked issue snapshots and attachments, each saved as an evidence file of this contract

source.description: One retrieved source. available requires file_id naming this contract's kind=evidence file; any other status requires a reason, and file_id may name partial data or be empty

url.description: Canonical browse URL https://<host>/browse/<ticket>, never a REST API endpoint

fetched_at.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp ending in Z

issue.description: Complete raw issue JSON with all fields, unabridged

fields.description: Field metadata saved as a bare top-level JSON array of objects with id and name

comments.description: Every raw comment page from start 0 to the total; with zero comments, exactly one page with start 0

linked.description: One snapshot per formal issue link of the ticket, no others

attachments.description: One entry per attachment in the raw issue: content is the downloaded bytes, analysis is mechanical extraction such as an unpacked bundle

analysis.description: When the file type needs no mechanical extraction (plain text, a single JSON document, an image), the content itself is the analysis: status available with the content's file_id. unsupported is for a file that needs extraction which cannot be done

complete.description: true only when every source is available and gaps is empty

gaps.description: Retrieval work that remains undone or failed; a genuine absence (no comments, no links, no attachments) is not a gap
